title: New consumer unit and extra sockets
description:
Job type: Consumer unit + sockets. Hi, we have just bought a 1930s terrace in Hebden Bridge. The house still has the old fuse box with ceramic fuses and there are only two double sockets downstairs. We would like a new consumer unit with RCBOs fitted, and four new double sockets fitted in the living room and kitchen (two each). The walls are brick with plaster, floorboards upstairs and concrete downstairs. There is a small under-stairs cupboard where the fuse box sits with about 30cm clearance. Parking is on the street outside the house, permit holders only until 6pm. We are flexible on timing but would prefer a weekday morning visit if possible.


Additional context from customer chat:
Assistant: Are the existing cables for the sockets accessible for installation, or will new cabling be required?
notes:
Customer reconfirmed dates via portal accept (22-24 Sep). Fuse box under stairs, 30cm clearance. Street parking permit until 6pm.

Customer confirmed preferred dates: 2026-09-22, 2026-09-23, 2026-09-24

AI quote assumptions:
- New cabling is required for the four additional sockets (customer did not confirm existing cable accessibility).
- Sockets will be flush-mounted in brick/plaster walls with cables routed via upstairs floorboard voids.
- Existing circuits are suitable for reconnection to the new consumer unit without a full rewire.
- Parking permit costs are excluded; customer to provide or reimburse if required before 6pm.
- No allowance for asbestos or redundant fabric-sheathed cabling removal.

AI notes: Customer specifically requested RCBOs—do not substitute a dual-RCD board. The 30cm clearance in the under-stairs cupboard may dictate a smaller chassis or rotated layout; verify on site. Prices are guide estimates only and exclude VAT.
